content: साटोप {%a.%} .²1 Elated or puffed up with pride, haughty. .²2 Majestic, stately. .²3 Swollen, filled or charged with (as with water); <ls>Pt. 1</ls>. .²4 Rumbling (as clouds). .{@-पम्@} {%ind.%} .²1 Proudly, arrogantly, in a stately manner, struttingly; as in साटोपं परिक्रामति. .²2 Angrily, furiously.
